commentaries.author: Parimelazhagar
commentaries.text:
Someone whom ascetics respect as wanting liberation and not scorning it must guard their heart from thinking of taking anything by deceit. To scorn liberation is to live by materialist books that deny rebirth. Even true teaching, taken from a teacher by deceit, is theft. For a renouncer, stealing means thinking of stealing.

எள்ளாமை plainly means not being scorned. He takes it as not scorning liberation.
